the rhizosphere provides a complex and dynamic environment for the development and interaction of microorganisms, which can result in enhanced biological disease control.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
microbial interactions in the rhizoplane are complex.
biocontrol is a complex phenomenon involving many interactions and that biocontrol is most successful when multiple microbial interactions are involved.
biocontrol agents are not only effective against plant pathogens, but they are also able to control the growth of other rhizosphere microorganisms, including other biocontrol agents.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the rhizosphere can be viewed as a complex and dynamic ecosystem in which the microbial community can be manipulated to provide enhanced bio-control of plant pathogens.
biocontrol is a complex process involving multiple mechanisms of action and that the use of multiple biocontrol agents can lead to enhanced biocontrol in some situations.

biocontrol agents can be used as a tool for improving plant growth and health, and that the rhizosphere can be considered as an ecosystem in which microbial interactions are the driving force for plant growth and health.
